REGULAR INCOME CERTIFICATES
REGULAR INCOME CERTIFICATES
RULES, 1993,
(Amendment of R.4)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
13th August, 2011]
S.R.O.
761(I)/2011, dated 11-8-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section
28 of the Public Debt Act, 1944 (XVIII of 1944), the Federal Government is
pleased to direct that the following further amendment shall be made in the
Regular Income Certificates Rules, 1993, the same having been previously
published vide Notification No. S.R.O. 593(I)/2011 dated the 8th June, 2011, as
required under subsection (1) of the said section, namely:--
In the aforesaid Rules, in rule 4, for clause (v),
the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(v) all institutional investment shall be
discontinued with immediate effect.".
